title: Bombay High Court declines urgent stay on Tata Trust meet
desc: The Bombay High Court has declined to halt a crucial meeting of Sir Ratan Tata Trust trustees scheduled for Friday. A petition argued the trust's board composition violates new Maharashtra laws. The court clarified the petitioner can seek further relief from a vacation bench. The meeting's agenda includes reviewing the Trusts' representation on Tata Sons' board.
